div.head: III Eg 6.2
div.ab: Gyf hit þyfð beo, ⁊ gyf he hine binnan twelf monðum gelangian mæge, agyfe hine to rihte, ⁊ him man agyfe þæt he ǽr sealde.
Gyf hit ðeof beo, ⁊ gif he hine binnan twelf monðum gelangian mæge, agyfe hine to rihte, ⁊ him man agyfe þæt he ær geald.
Gif hit þeof beo, ⁊ gyf he hine binnan XII monðum gelangian mæge, agyfe hine to rihte, ⁊ him man agyfe þæt he ær geald.
Si latro plegiatus aufugiat, et plegius infra XII menses possit eum rehabere, reddat eum ad rectum et rehabeat quicquid ante propter hoc dederat.
Gif hit þonne þeof beo, ⁊ gif he hine þonne binnan XII monðum gelangian mæge, agife hine to rihte, ⁊ him man agife þæt he ær geald.
And if the case be that of a thief, and his surety can lay hold of him within twelve months, he shall deliver him up to justice, and what he has paid shall be returned to him.
Wenn es (nun D) ein Dieb(stahl G) ist, und wenn der [Bürge] ihn (dann D) binnen 12 Monaten fassen kann, liefere er ihn dem Gerichte aus, und was er zuvor bezahlt hatte, werde ihm zurückgegeben.
If it is (then, D) a thief (theft, G), and if the [surety] can (then, D) seize him within 12 months, let him deliver him up to justice, and let what he had paid before be given back to him.
div.note: G's ‘þyfð’ should be corrected to ‘þeof’ from A, D, G2 and Quadr.?
